package.name: chrono_split_ecu
package.description: Virtual ECU node for the split ros2_control / ECU / FMU-dynamics architecture: subscribes EcuCommand (from ros2_control's chrono_split_ecu_bridge_hw_interface, Bridge 1), publishes VehicleCommand (to the FMU dynamics node, Bridge 2), and the reverse for status. Owns the velocity->torque control loop and unit conversions -- see ../../README.md.
